hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: We need powerful integers in [start, finish]. Compute count_upto(finish) - count_upto(start - 1).

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Every powerful integer must end with suffix string s and have all digits <= limit.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Use digit DP over the prefix digits preceding s to count valid numbers bounded by N.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Digit DP counting prefixes of valid length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear iteration up to 10^15 causes time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(log10(N)) recursion stack and memo table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use digit DP on prefix digits with suffix validation.
